svg.title: Expand and Contract
svg.desc: Expand and Contract. Change a schema or API in backward-compatible steps: expand, migrate, then contract. Step 1, One-step rename breaks: Rename phone in one step: every v1 instance still running fails, and redeploying v1 cannot fix it. Step 2, Expand: Expand: add phone_number beside phone, then roll out v1.1, which writes both. v1 keeps working. Step 3, Migrate: Migrate: backfill the old rows in batches, compare the columns, then switch reads to phone_number. Step 4, Contract: Contract: v2 stops writing phone, then a later release drops it. Only the drop cannot be undone.

g.text: Rename phone in one step: every v1 instance still running fails, and redeploying v1 cannot fix it.
Expand: add phone_number beside phone, then roll out v1.1, which writes both. v1 keeps working.
Migrate: backfill the old rows in batches, compare the columns, then switch reads to phone_number.
Contract: v2 stops writing phone, then a later release drops it. Only the drop cannot be undone.
